name: CGMacros participant 4
about: Woman, 33, BMI 42. Wore two glucose sensors and a Fitbit for about ten days and photographed every meal; carbs, protein and fat were estimated from the photos.

credit.cite: Gutierrez-Osuna R, Kerr D, Mortazavi B, Das A. CGMacros: a scientific dataset for personalized nutrition and diet monitoring (v1.0.0). PhysioNet, 2025.
